fusions.name: Skinned Knuckles
fusions.desc: A bare-knuckle punch that costs 4% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silverback Slam
fusions.desc: Brings both fists down on the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bough Swing
fusions.desc: Swings you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Thick Wrists
fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your maximum health rises by 10, from silver you attack 5% faster, and from gold your armour rises by 5%.
